# Valerian Pereira

> Head of Data Team at BookMyShow, based in Mumbai, India — the data platform,
> analytics and data science. Fifteen years building data
> platforms, APIs and the infrastructure underneath them. Builds developer
> tooling and command-line utilities in the open.

The home page at https://valerianpereira.in/ has two views of the same
content: a SQL console you can query, and a conventional CV below it. Each
Android app also has its own page (listed under Apps). Every fact below is
present in the pages' rendered HTML and in their schema.org JSON-LD.

## Current role

- **Head of Data Team (Engineering Manager III)**, BookMyShow, Apr 2024 –
  present. Owns the data function end to end across three groups: the data
  platform (Databricks and AWS infrastructure, ingestion and warehousing, data
  operations), analytics and the reporting and reconciliation systems the
  business runs on, and data science.

## What the team has shipped

Nine initiatives, queryable on the page as `SELECT * FROM shipped;`.

Data platform:
- Legacy back-office reports migrated onto a Databricks app reading the lake.
- Daily pipelines across every payment gateway into one reconciliation report.
- Drop-off widget moved from a third-party SDK onto in-house event data.

Analytics:
- Experiment reporting moved onto analytics data; the experimentation vendor
  scoped down to assignment only.
- AWS QuickSight sunset onto Databricks, which already held the data.
- Agentic workflow replacing a manual customer-data handoff to marketing tools.
- Delta Sharing so partners read data directly instead of waiting on extracts.

Data science:
- Recommendation app moved to Go and Redis; Aerospike dropped from the stack.
- Abusive-review detection and summarisation on LLM APIs, running daily.

## Apps

Free Android apps, published as signed Play bundles. No ads, no accounts, no
analytics, no third-party SDKs; nothing leaves the phone.

- **What is this?** — https://valerianpereira.in/what-is-this/ (source:
  https://github.com/valerianpereira/what-is-this-app). Picture-naming game for
  2–4 year olds. A real Wikimedia Commons photo appears, the child says the word
  out loud, and after a 3, 5 or 8 second countdown the phone's own text-to-speech
  says it back. 22 groups, 325 words (Animals, Fruits, Vehicles, Body Parts,
  Toys, School Things, Shapes, Colours and more); ten pictures a round with a
  summary of the words seen. Parent zone behind a 2-second hold: progress per
  group, voice on/off, photo credits, one-tap download of every picture for
  offline use. Built as one vanilla HTML/CSS/JS file (~650 lines) wrapped in a
  Capacitor 8 WebView; photos fetched via jsDelivr and cached by a service
  worker, so the APK is about 4 MB. One permission: INTERNET, for card photos.
- **Tambola: Housie Caller** — https://valerianpereira.in/tambola/ (source:
  https://github.com/valerianpereira/tambola-app). Tambola (Housie) number
  caller that runs on one phone. Calls 1–90 out loud with the traditional
  rhymes ("Legs eleven", "Two little ducks"), shows the full colour-coded 9×10
  board with the last call ringed, auto-calls every 5, 7 or 10 seconds or steps
  manually, undoes the last call, tracks prizes (Early Five, Top/Middle/Bottom
  Row, Full House), keeps counters and a game timer, light and dark themes.
  Fully offline, zero network requests. React 19 + Vite (~1.2k lines), wrapped
  with Capacitor 8 and its TTS plugin.

## Open source

- [backup-action](https://github.com/valerianpereira/backup-action) — GitHub
  Action that backs up MySQL, MongoDB and PostgreSQL databases and directories
  over SSH. 54 stars; published on the GitHub Marketplace.
- [fifa-wc26](https://github.com/valerianpereira/fifa-wc26) — World Cup 2026 in
  the terminal: fixtures, live scores, group standings, ASCII bracket.
- [npx valerianpereira](https://github.com/valerianpereira/npx_valerianpereira)
  — a business card that prints into your shell.
- [who-is](https://github.com/valerianpereira/who-is) — Alexa skill for domain
  WHOIS, expiry and hosting details.
- [alexa-rail-info](https://github.com/valerianpereira/alexa-rail-info) — Alexa
  skill for Indian Railways: cancellations, reschedules, PNR status.
- [webuzo-docker-centos](https://github.com/valerianpereira/webuzo-docker-centos)
  — the Webuzo hosting control panel in a single container.
